results.controlling_authority_on_mismatch: CCP 1161(2) - a residential 3-day pay-or-quit MUST state 'the name, telephone number, and address of the person to whom the rent payment shall be made, and, if payment may be made personally, the usual days and hours' for payment. Strict compliance required; omission of a mandatory element is fatal to the UD. Eshagian v. Cepeda (2025) (3-day notice voided for failing statutorily mandated content, incl. clear payment information); CACI No. 4303 (sufficiency of notice; strict compliance); Lynch & Freytag v. Cooper (1990) 218 Cal.App.3d 603 (failure to satisfy 1161(2) content requirements is fatal to the UD). Cf. Lee v. Koyluk (2021) 59 Cal.App.5th 719 (PERSUASIVE, not controlling; a 1161(3) covenant case - court noted 1161(2), unlike (3), contains express identification language, corroborating that (2) imposes this requirement).
